pairs: A Psalm of David versus Goliath.
qui docet manus meas ad prælium,
who trains my hands for the battle
and my fingers for the war.
protector meus, et in ipso speravi,
my protector and him in whom I have hoped:
qui subdit populum meum sub me.
he subdues my people under me.
quid est homo, quia innotuisti ei?
what is man that you have become known to him?
aut filius hominis, quia reputas eum?
Or the son of man that you consider him?
Man has been made similar to vanity.
His days pass by like a shadow.
and you will set them in disarray.
Send forth your hand from on high:
et libera me de aquis multis,
and free me from many waters,
from the hand of the sons of foreigners.
Their mouth has been speaking vain things,
and their right hand is the right hand of iniquity.
O God, I will sing a new song. On the psaltery,
with an instrument of ten strings, I will sing psalms to you.
qui redemisti David servum tuum de gladio maligno,
He has redeemed your servant David from the malignant sword.
et erue me de manu filiorum alienorum,
and deliver me from the hand of the sons of foreigners.
Their mouth has been speaking vain things,
and their right hand is the right hand of iniquity.
Quorum filii sicut novellæ plantationes in juventute sua;
Their sons are like new plantings in their youth.
adorned all around like the idols of a temple.
overflowing from one thing into another.
nor anyone crying out in their streets.
Beatum dixerunt populum cui hæc sunt;
They have called the people that has these things:
beatus populus cujus Dominus Deus ejus.
blessed. But blessed is the people whose God is the Lord.
